guide_line: Name an ionic compound, or write its formula.
steps: Write the cation first, then the anion.
A monatomic anion ends in -ide. Use the polyatomic name as it is: nitrate, sulfate, phosphate, carbonate, hydroxide.
Crisscross the charges, then reduce. Put parentheses around a polyatomic ion used more than once.
A transition metal gets a Roman numeral for its charge.
For a formula, use symbols such as Al2O3. For a name, use words.

worked_example.q: Write the formula for aluminum oxide.

similar_problem.q: Write the formula for calcium phosphate.
